name: com.bankruptcyobserver/mcp
title: Bankruptcy Observer
description: US business bankruptcy MCP: filings, dockets, documents, case summaries. Free name/case-number lookups; paid tools with a subscription. Plans and pricing: https://www.bankruptcyobserver.com/pricing. Contact: https://www.bankruptcyobserver.com/contact.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer MCP API token for subscriber tools. Optional for free-tier name and case-number lookups. Obtain via list_plans_tool then purchase_plan_tool (token appears in the bankruptcyobserver.com subscriber dashboard; it is not emailed). X-API-Key also supported.
